definitions.gloss: month (suffix forming the names of calendar months)
definitions.explanation: Attached to the numbers one through twelve to name the months of the year: {一月|いちがつ} (January), {二月|にがつ} (February), and so on. It names a month of the calendar, not a length of time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{四月|しがつ}→四月：00668_shigatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入学|にゅうがく}する→入学する：01851_nyuugakusuru⟧。
⟦{誕生日|たんじょうび}→誕生日：02910_tanjoubi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{十二月|じゅうにがつ}→十二月：00636_juunigatsu⟧です。
⟦{八月|はちがつ}→八月：00626_hachigatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{暑|あつ}い→暑い：00619_atsui⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{九月|くがつ}→九月：00646_kugatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: August is hot, so let's make the trip in September.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{決算|けっさん}→決算：05973_kessan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三月|さんがつ}→三月：00665_sangatsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{年度|ねんど}→年度：00309_nendo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{四月|しがつ}→四月：00668_shigatsu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: The company closes its books in March, and the new fiscal year begins in April.

notes:
Only the reading がつ is used for month names; the same kanji read ⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧ is the independent noun for "moon" or "month."

COUNTING PATTERNS:
- ⟦{四月|しがつ}→四月：00668_shigatsu⟧: April — し, never よん
- ⟦{七月|しちがつ}→七月：00667_shichigatsu⟧: July — しち, never なな
- ⟦{九月|くがつ}→九月：00646_kugatsu⟧: September — く, never きゅう

SIMILAR WORDS:
- か{月|げつ}: months (duration) — ⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧か{月|げつ} is "three months long," while ⟦{三月|さんがつ}→三月：00665_sangatsu⟧ is "March"
- ⟦{月|つき}→月：02230_tsuki⟧: moon; month — the independent noun

Question word: ⟦{何月|なんがつ}→何月：22086_nangatsu⟧ (what month).

cross_references.reason: the same kanji read つき, the independent noun for moon and month
